package.name: safedrl_drone_nav
package.description:
Safe deep-reinforcement-learning drone navigation with control-barrier-function enforcement.
A constrained (Lagrangian) PPO policy flies a quadrotor through a slalom of gates in a PyBullet corridor populated with static and dynamic obstacles and subject to discrete wind gusts, while a discrete-time control-barrier-function safety filter constrains the velocity command so that the vehicle can always still come to a stop before contact. The package ships a fully reproducible training/evaluation pipeline, an automatic run-trace and evidence generator, and ROS nodes that run the same observation builder and the same safety filter on live topics.
